summary_en: 900,000 shares (2.1% of outstanding shares) to be acquired at 3,160 yen per share on October 14, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading, for a total of up to 2.844 billion yen as part of flexible capital management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Market Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, the board of directors resolved to execute an acquisition of 900,000 treasury shares of DOUTOR·NICHIRES Holdings Co., Ltd. via off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3). The shares will be purchased at the closing price of 3,160 yen on October 13, 2026, on October 14, 2026, at 08:45 Japan Standard Time. The total acquisition amount will not exceed 2.844 billion yen. This represents 2.1% of the 42,074,412 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026).

The company stated that the acquisition is part of flexible capital management in response to changes in the operating environment. The purchase order will be valid only for the specified trading session. The company will announce the results of the acquisition immediately after the conclusion of trading on October 14, 2026.
